payload.name: Include Preference Memories for Like and Favorite Searches
payload.description: When a question asks what a person likes, prefers, or considers a favorite, do not restrict retrieval to profile memories; include preference memories when searching and before concluding no information.
content: When a question asks what someone likes, prefers, or considers a favorite, do not restrict retrieval to memory_kind 'profile'; include 'preference' memories because likes and favorites are often stored there.

For shared-interest questions (what do two people both like), run each person's search with preference-aware queries (e.g., '<name> prefers', '<name> favorite', '<name> likes') and compare the returned objects; if the first search yields no preference memory, repeat once without the memory_kind filter before concluding missing evidence.
Stop after one broadened search per person yields no relevant preference memory, then answer from visible evidence.

solves: Access agents answering shared-interest or preference questions may restrict searches to profile memories and miss preference memories, leading to false 'no information' answers. This skill ensures preference memory kind is included when searching what people like, prefer, or consider favorites, and when intersecting commonalities between two people.
